## 2. Complete 11-Dish Culinary Portfolio
1. **Classic Chicken Rolex (Live Tawa Station):** Hand-rolled golden chapati filled with fresh herb omelette, tender marinated chicken breast strips, tomatoes, cabbage, and fresh Kachumbari salsa.
2. **Classic Veggie & Vegan Rolex (Live Tawa Station):** Artisan chapati rolled with crunchy market vegetables, red onions, vine tomatoes, and avocado or herb omelette.
3. **Traditional Ugandan Beef Stew (Chafing-Dish Buffet):** Prime beef cubes slow-braised for hours in a rich East African tomato, onion, garlic, and aromatic spice gravy.
4. **Crispy Herb Chicken Drumsticks (Buffet & Fingerfood):** Golden-brown roasted chicken drumsticks seasoned with traditional Ugandan herbs, ginger, and garlic.
5. **Glazed BBQ & Meat Platter (Buffet & Fingerfood):** Succulent glazed meat bites grilled with East African spices, garnished with fresh herbs and house barbecue dip.
6. **Whole Crispy Tilapia Fish (Lake Victoria Specialty):** Whole crispy fried Tilapia fish seasoned with lemon, ginger, garlic, and mild chili, served as a festive centerpiece.
7. **Golden Beef & Veggie Samosas (Fingerfood):** Hand-folded crispy pastry triangles filled with either spiced minced beef or curried potatoes and green peas.
8. **East African Spiced Pilau Rice (Buffet Side):** Fragrant basmati rice cooked in rich stock with whole cardamom pods, cinnamon, cloves, cumin, and caramelized onions.
9. **Roasted Plantains / Gonja & Matoke (Vegan Side):** Sweet ripe plantains caramelized to golden perfection alongside traditional green banana specialties.
10. **Kachumbari Salad & Creamy Peanut Sauce (G-Nut Sauce):** Fresh East African tomato-onion-cilantro salad paired with velvety Ugandan roasted groundnut sauce.
11. **Swahili Mandazi with Organic Honey (Dessert):** Warm, fluffy East African cardamom-coconut dough pastries drizzled with pure blossom honey.

## 3. Catering Packages & Pricing (Munich & Bavaria)
- **Package 1: Live Ugandan Rolex Station (from 18.00 € p.P.)**
  - Ideal for: Corporate lunches, summer parties, trade fair stands, wedding receptions, midnight snacks.
  - Throughput: Approx. 3 minutes per freshly grilled Rolex; high speed for 50 to 500+ guests.
- **Package 2: Flying Fingerfood & Platters (from 22.00 € p.P.)**
  - Ideal for: Champagne receptions, networking events, gallery openings, office get-togethers.
  - Features: 100% handheld (no cutlery required) — Mini-Rolex tapas skewers, golden samosas, glazed meat bites, and Mandazi puffs.
- **Package 3: Festive Chafing-Dish Warm Buffet (from 28.50 € p.P.)**
  - Ideal for: Seated corporate dinners, Christmas parties (Weihnachtsfeiern), weddings, milestone birthdays.
  - Features: Stainless steel chafing dishes, Beef Stew, Crispy Chicken, Pilau Rice, Roasted Plantains, G-Nut Sauce, and salad bar.
- **Package 4: VIP Combo Experience — Live Station + Warm Buffet (from 34.50 € p.P.)**
  - Ideal for: Flagship gala events, large weddings, executive summits.
  - Features: Combines the live Tawa show-cooking entertainment with the full hot chafing-dish buffet and dessert bar.

## 4. Technical & Operational FAQs for Event Planners
- **How much space and power do you need?** Only 3x3 meters of floor space and a standard 230V power socket. We bring all tables, stainless steel chafing dishes, cast-iron Tawa grills, and hygienic sneeze guards.
- **Do you cater for mixed dietary groups (Meat Lovers + Vegans)?** Yes. Every buffet and live station offers hearty meat/poultry/fish specialties alongside 100% vegan and lactose-free dishes, clearly labeled at the buffet.
- **How fast do we receive a quote?** Within 24 hours via email (`info@kampalarolex.de`) or immediately via WhatsApp (`+49 152 14438923`).
